about: Reference model-computation digests. A conformant engine must reproduce each `model_digest` bit-for-bit on any CPU vendor or instruction set, under the stated regime. The digest binds the run under the domain separator below (see the vitnify-receipt spec).

vectors.notes: model_digest is tier-1 v2 (binds the regime); model_digest_v1 is the frozen tier-1 v1 digest for the same run, retained for pre-regime receipts.
